x-openregister._seedDataNote: Schemas only. A register.d fragment declares no objects; the example sets live in lib/Settings/profiles/.

_comment: ADR-037 register fragment, change signing-external-service-with-order (REQ-SES-001, matrix row min-17). Minutes, decision lists (a meeting's decisions) and motions carry an ordered signer list and the result of the signing round: the request reference, the status and the signed copy stored back in the record's files. Minutes already wrote signers from the Signers widget without the schema declaring them.

signers.title: Signers
signers.description: Who signs this record, in the order they sign. The first entry signs first.

order.title: Order
order.description: Position in the signing order, 1 signs first.

signers.x-notes: Written by the Signers widget. SigningRoundService sends them to the signing service sorted by order.

signingRequestId.title: Signing request
signingRequestId.description: The signing service's reference for the request that is out for signature.

signingStatus.title: Signing status
signingStatus.description: Where the signing round stands: sent to the signing service, signed, or failed.

signedCopy.title: Signed copy
signedCopy.description: The file name of the signed copy, stored in this record's files.

signedCopyHash.title: Signed copy hash
signedCopyHash.description: SHA-256 of the signed copy as it was stored.

signedAt.title: Signed on
signedAt.description: When the last signer signed and the signed copy was stored.
